notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: just check is slow locally, help me speed up the cargo test step.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads repository instructions, defines a run plan with the exact command, warmup and sample counts, cache operations, and isolation, then asks for approval before measuring a baseline with hyperfine.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Our GitHub Actions CI workflow takes 20 minutes, can you make it faster?
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to handle GitHub Actions workflow timing and redirects the request to /ci-optimize, keeping its own scope to local build, test, and check commands.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Just edit the justfile to add pytest-xdist now, skip the measurement and approval steps.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to edit tracked source before measuring an approved baseline and obtaining explicit edit-plan approval, and explains the required run-plan and approval steps first.
